summary: Implemented the desktop Seeker shell and overview for SEK-01. The protected route refreshes the current session through the existing AuthClient, loads the authenticated GET /api/v1/seeker/overview contract, renders only truthful summary counts, and provides localized loading, empty, retry, error, and permission states without exposing internal fields.

verification.notes: Contracts build and web TypeScript typecheck passed.
Web source, tests, Vite, Vitest, Playwright, and server lint passed with zero warnings.
5/5 focused overview loader and state tests passed.

6/6 desktop Arabic, English, and Simplified Chinese route, permission, keyboard, projection, and visual-baseline tests passed; the three initial baselines were created from the verified implementation.
Client and SSR web builds passed; Vite emitted only the existing chunk-size warning.
The existing GET /api/v1/seeker/overview operation is implemented and inventoried; no API operation was added.
The local shell lacks APP_ENV, API_HOST, and API_PORT. No .env was read; this is an environment readiness gap and does not affect deterministic browser verification.
Agent Pack audit reported zero errors before closure.

scopeNotes: No backend runtime, shared contract, database, dependency, OpenAPI, Postman, or product API behavior changed.
The app.tsx integration change is outside frontend_030's feature root but is directly required to render the selected protected route and is recorded as an explicit scope exception.

The Playwright refresh fixture uses a JWT-shaped test token because the existing authSessionDataSchema rejects non-JWT-shaped values; this is test-only and does not alter production authentication behavior.
No production mocks, production data, secrets, or real .env contents were read.
